title: One Platform, Zero Switching Between Tools #analytics #startup
description:
PostHog explained: one install gives you product analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments, and a data warehouse — 19 products on a single SDK, instead of paying 5 separate vendors. Here's how the all-in-one PostHog platform actually works.

What you'll see in this ~3-minute PostHog breakdown:
- Why the usual analytics stack (Amplitude + Hotjar + LaunchDarkly + Optimizely + Snowflake) means 5 SDKs, 5 bills, and glue code
- How one PostHog install collapses analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments and a data warehouse into one platform — with autocapture, no tracking code
- The one shared data model underneath: one identity, one event stream, no reconciliation
- Why PostHog runs on ClickHouse — billions of events a day, most funnels back in about a second
- PostHog's MCP server: ask "what are my top errors this week?" and a coding agent pulls the stack trace and drafts the pull request from inside your editor
- PostHog Code (early preview): a swarm of agents that clusters errors, ships low-risk PRs, then reverts if the metric didn't move
- The free tier — 1M events + 5k recordings a month, and the honest catch (overwhelm + itemized billing)
